title: Creamy Golden Jersey Potatoes
description: A rich and indulgent side dish featuring golden jersey potatoes, topped with a creamy kissed golden sauce.
instructions: Peel and slice the potatoes to 1/4 inch thickness.
In a saucepan, melt the Canadian butter over medium heat.
Add the Golden Jersey Potatoes to the saucepan and toss to coat with the butter.
Transfer the potato mixture to a baking dish and dot the top with the Kissed Golden Sauce.
Sprinkle the Royal Salt over the top and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until golden brown.
Garnish with chopped fresh chives and serve hot.
